task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a PennyLane program with a QNode that applies RX(1.495) and RY(0.841) to one qubit and returns <Z>. Print the result and the analytic value cos(1.495)*cos(0.841). Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
